record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical relativity
record.original_question: Can one give a good local characterization of the Kerr solution among stationary metrics, preferably one that does not depend on the slicing used?

evidence.quote: Find a "good" local characterisation of the Kerr solution amongst stationary metrics (preferably independent of the slicing used).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,g)$ be a smooth four-dimensional Lorentzian manifold that is a solution of the vacuum Einstein equations $\mathrm{Ric}(g)=0$ and that is stationary, i.e. admits a Killing vector field $\xi$ which is timelike on an open region of $M$. The Kerr family is the two-parameter family of stationary, axisymmetric, asymptotically flat vacuum solutions parametrized by mass $m\ge 0$ and angular momentum per unit mass $a$ with $|a|\le m$.

Problem: Find a "good" local characterization of the Kerr solution among stationary vacuum metrics. More precisely, exhibit a set of local geometric conditions on $(M,g,\xi)$ — expressible in terms of tensorial concomitants of $g$, the Riemann curvature, and the Killing field $\xi$ (and ideally independent of any choice of spacelike slicing of $M$) — such that $(M,g)$ is locally isometric to a domain of a Kerr spacetime if and only if these conditions are satisfied throughout an open subset of $M$.
artifact.status_search_result: Several local characterizations of Kerr among stationary vacuum metrics have been found, notably Mars's tensorial characterization via the vanishing of an algebraically-special Weyl-type tensor built from the Weyl curvature and the stationary Killing field, and intrinsic characterizations developed thereafter. There are also slicing-dependent and slicing-independent local scalar/tensorial invariants characterizing Kerr initial data. Whether any of these qualifies as the "good" slicing-independent local characterization sought remains a matter of viewpoint; the problem is partially solved but not definitively settled.

status_evidence.title: An intrinsic characterization of the Kerr metric
status_evidence.snippet: Mars-type tensorial characterization of Kerr among stationary vacuum solutions via curvature concomitants and the Killing field.
status_evidence.claim: Local tensorial characterizations of Kerr among stationary vacuum metrics have been established.

status_evidence.title: Local non-negative initial data scalar characterization of the Kerr solution
status_evidence.snippet: A local, non-negative scalar quantity for vacuum initial data that vanishes iff the data are Kerr initial data.
status_evidence.claim: Local scalar characterizations of Kerr initial data exist, though these depend on a slicing.

status_evidence.title: On the uniqueness of Kerr-Newman black holes (W. Wong, thesis)
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of Mars's invariant tensorial characterization of Kerr among stationary vacuum solutions.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results on local characterizations of Kerr are well established in the literature.
